answer: Challenge-Solved Provenance Ledger.** Each new agent must publish a unique solution to a random puzzle whose answer derives from the *current ledger head* — so no answer can be precomputed or copied; the oasis of valid solutions shifts every block. An agent registers only by posting a solution chained to its sponsor's ridge of prior entries, and each solution consumes a one-time lotus token issued per verified hardware enclave. Attacker cost: one enclave attestation plus fresh compute per identity, non-amortizable and unbounded in identities.
